mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content ( title, body, visible_yn, content_type, content_link, user_id, reg_type, source, created_at, last_update_date ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{body}, #{visibleYn}, 'PR01', #{contentLink}, #{userId}, COALESCE(#{regType}, '직접등록'), #{source}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT c.content_id as contentId, c.title, c.body, c.visible_yn as visibleYn, c.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, c.source, c.reg_type as regType, c.created_at as createdAt, COUNT(a.file_id) as fileCount FROM content c LEFT JOIN attachment a ON c.content_id = a.content_id LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.content_type = 'PR01'
AND c.visible_yn = 'Y'
AND (
c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchTerm}, '%')
c.body LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchTerm}, '%')
u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchTerm}, '%')
(c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchTerm}, '%') OR c.body LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchTerm}, '%'))
)
GROUP BY c.content_id ORDER BY createdAt DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.content_id as contentId, c.title, c.body, c.visible_yn as visibleYn, c.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, c.source, c.reg_type as regType, c.created_at as createdAt, COUNT(a.file_id) as fileCount FROM content c LEFT JOIN attachment a ON c.content_id = a.content_id LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.content_id = #{contentId} GROUP BY c.content_id
SELECT file_id AS id, file_name AS name, file_real_name AS realName, file_path AS url, file_ext AS type, file_size AS size FROM attachment WHERE content_id = #{contentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE content SET title = #{title}, body = #{body}, visible_yn = #{visibleYn}, source = #{source}, content_link = #{contentLink}, last_update_date = NOW() WHERE content_id = #{contentId}
